business: Mastering English Library: free English lessons site (B1-C2) with printable PDFs and a paid PDF store
question: You found this site from a post. Would you use it, would you pay for any pack, and what would you change?

segments.name: Preparing for IELTS for a job or a scholarship
Working adult who needs English at work
Parent looking for help for a teenager
Owner or manager of a small tutoring centre

behaviours.name: Free-only learner
behaviours.how: Learns from YouTube and free PDFs; rarely pays for study material.

behaviours.name: Exam-driven
behaviours.how: Pays quickly for anything that helps before a test date.

behaviours.name: Trusts Arabic explanations
behaviours.how: Buys only material that explains in Arabic and fits Arabic speakers' mistakes.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Will not pay a new site until they see reviews, a sample or a friend who used it.

behaviours.name: Prefers a teacher or an app
behaviours.how: Would rather pay a tutor, a course or an app than buy PDFs.

behaviours.name: Bulk buyer for a class
behaviours.how: Wants class sets, worksheets with answers and an invoice.

behaviours.name: Impulse buyer from Instagram
behaviours.how: Buys a cheap pack straight from a post if checkout is easy.

objections: Prices in dollars and paying a foreign site feels risky
I can find free PDFs anywhere
I don't know who is behind this site
PDFs alone don't make me speak
Is the level right for me?
Can I use it with a whole class?
Too much English on the page
habits: you study on your phone, rarely on a laptop
you share useful links in WhatsApp groups
you prepare worksheets on Thursday for next week
you have a test date in two months
you check prices in rials before buying anything online
extra_seed: Payment on the store: card or PayPal, or a mobile transfer that the owner confirms by hand. Prices are in US dollars. The store is on Wix (masteringenglishlibrary.com).
